name: cider-control
title: Cider Control
description: Search and control Cider playback from Raycast
author: luis_14

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Music
commands.description: Search Apple Music and play via Cider

commands.name: next-track
commands.title: Go to the Next Track
commands.description: Goes to the next track in the queue

commands.name: previous-track
commands.title: Go to the Previous Track
commands.description: Goes to the previous track in the queue

commands.name: queue
commands.title: Queue
commands.description: Lets you change see the song queue and change if you want

commands.name: library
commands.title: Search Your Library
commands.description: Lets you play an album from your library

commands.name: now-playing
commands.title: Now Playing
commands.description: See info about the music that you're listening to right now

commands.name: volume
commands.description: Set the playback volume in Cider

preferences.name: token
preferences.title: Cider API Token
preferences.description: Your API Token from Cider Settings -> Connectivity

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
